CopilotChat: Use Microsoft 365 admin center Copilot usage reports for Chat populations. Keep portal reporting dates and population with the evidence; current licenses cannot classify historical audit users.
CopilotOptimization: Reconcile license assignments, returned usage dates and user identities. Review Microsoft 365 admin center recommendations and have the customer approve any license changes.
CopilotPrompts: The licensed usage report supplies counts, not full conversation content. Use an authorized Purview eDiscovery workflow when conversation evidence is required; access and retention are separate.
DataAccessGovernance: Use SharePoint admin center > Reports > Data access governance to generate missing scoped reports. Wait for completion, then rerun -IncludeDAG. Open the downloaded artifacts, not just the inventory CSV.
AdvancedManagement: Review SharePoint admin center lifecycle and site access review settings/results. The tenant/site snapshots do not establish remediation completion.
OneDrivePermissions: Use existing DAG exports plus an approved -IncludeItemPermissions -DriveIds scan for selected drives. For full ACL/inheritance review, inspect the relevant sites and items; a bounded scan cannot prove tenant-wide completeness.
AuditEvidence: Use Purview Audit to verify search scope, retention and ingestion. This collector searches CopilotInteraction only; perform additional authorized searches for other operations.
DlpEffectiveness: Review returned policies/rules and Activity Explorer events with the customer. Run customer-approved enforcement tests for targeted users, locations, exclusions and modes; configuration alone cannot prove effectiveness.
DSPMForAI: Review Microsoft Purview DSPM for AI assessments and recommendations in the portal. Save available exports or dated screenshots with the scope; this script collects related activity metadata only.
DSPM: Review Microsoft Purview DSPM posture assessments in the portal. Save available exports or dated evidence; a complete native posture collector is not implemented.
ComplianceManager: Use Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager assessment export, preserving assessment name, date, improvement actions and evidence. This script has no full Compliance Manager collector.
InsiderRisk: Have an authorized Insider Risk Management reviewer capture required policy, analytics and case evidence through Purview. Respect pseudonymization and case access. This script has no full Insider Risk collector.
DefenderConfiguration: Use -IncludeEndpoint with an approved ApiClientId for endpoint recommendations. Review other Defender XDR workload settings in their portals; the MDO/EOP configuration exports do not cover all XDR products.
SecurityCopilotConfiguration: Use Security Copilot settings to review capacity, roles, plugins/connections and workspace settings; capture authorized evidence. No full Security Copilot configuration collector is implemented.
AgentInventory: Use -IncludeAgentCatalog for Graph catalog packages/details (Agent 365 license and CopilotPackages.Read.All consent required), plus -IncludeAgents -ApiClientId with approved DataverseUrls for Copilot Studio bots. Reconcile both with Microsoft 365 admin center agent inventory. Neither covers every unpublished or unregistered external agent.
CopilotStudioSecurity: Collect approved Dataverse bot records, then review each agent in Copilot Studio for authentication, publication/sharing, knowledge sources, actions and connectors. Bot table fields do not establish effective access.
PowerPlatformConfiguration: Review Power Platform admin center capacity, environment security, DLP scope and connector usage alongside the collected environments/apps/flows. Additional environment settings need separate evidence.
FabricConfigurationUsage: Use -IncludeFabric -ApiClientId with approved Fabric permissions. For remaining coverage, review Fabric admin portal tenant/capacity settings, workspace access and activity/usage evidence; accessible capacities are not tenant-wide inventory.
TeamsPolicies: Review effective user/group policy assignments and app-centric access in Teams admin center. The collected policy definitions alone do not establish which policy applies to each user.
ExpansionGates: Have the named customer business and control owners review the evidence and record approval. The script cannot make or infer these approvals.
